title: Argus AI
summary: Argus AI is a privacy-preserving 'digital employee twin' platform for detecting insider threats in Indian banking, combining 211 engineered behavioral features with LightGBM/XGBoost/LSTM-AE risk models and SHAP/Gemini explainability. An experiment script trains the standalone CTGAN library on real insider feature vectors to generate synthetic minority-class samples for the insider-threat detector.
